name: fetch_tensorrt
purpose: resumable download of the TensorRT 11.3.0.99 cu13 wheels (Python 3.11, win_amd64) after the CST download has finished; sha256 from pypi.nvidia.com; installation is done by hand after a pip dry run

jobs.name: sha256
cmd: import hashlib,sys; want={'docs/environments/wheels/tensorrt_cu13_libs-11.3.0.99-py3-none-win_amd64.whl':'9d504bd9f77a93b30f5c782c1a3cb3f4e53595ea100347360134e5adea198eff','docs/environments/wheels/tensorrt_cu13_bindings-11.3.0.99-cp311-none-win_amd64.whl':'4d1c7a6a053b429edae72ffdb7ad719a3a38bc027734f5d6ae8d5ce9c97ef403'}; bad=[p for p,h in want.items() if hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()!=h]; print('sha256 ok' if not bad else 'MISMATCH '+str(bad)); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
